title: Remaining-Term Scale on the Noticed Termination Damages Rate
content:
*Scope: Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts. Subject: noticed terminations: remaining-term scale.*

The damages rate of a noticed termination is scaled by the whole months left in its term, counted from the termination effective date to the contract end date with a partial final month left out: fewer than 12 whole months scale it by 0.70, 12 up to 23 whole months scale it by 0.85, and 24 or more leave it unscaled. Scaling multiplies the damages rate per kWh by the figure shown.

Whole months are calendar months counted from the termination effective date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the termination effective date; a final part-month is not counted.

| Whole months left | Damages rate multiplied by |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | 0.70 |
| 12 to 23 | 0.85 |
| 24 or more | 1, unscaled |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical)

| Termination effective date | Contract end date | Whole months left | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 May 2026 | 4 May 2027 | 11 | 0.70 |
| 5 May 2026 | 5 May 2027 | 12 | 0.85 |
| 1 February 2026 | 31 January 2028 | 23 | 0.85 |
| 1 February 2026 | 1 February 2028 | 24 | 1 |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A rate of $0.0060 per kWh with 19 whole months left becomes 0.0060 multiplied by 0.85, that is $0.0051 per kWh.
